summary.headline: Astrological Calculation and Aspect Rules
summary.text: Astrological calculation of answer letters using place, sign, ruler, star, and elevated quantities, followed by rules for trines and aspects involving the Sun, Venus, Mars, and Saturn. A worked horoscope-ascension correction example is given, followed by two astrological tables and a marginal inquiry dated 1162 by Ioannes Synadinos.
